items.title: Claude Code 2.1.316 released
items.text: Added CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ULTRATHINK, which turns the ultrathink keyword off · Added pooled group budgets to the Claude apps gateway: one monthly budget that a group's members share, on top of each member's own limit, set with pooled_budget on the spend limits admin API · Added CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_LOOPED_CROSS_CERT_DROP to keep system cross-certificates that certify each other in a loop, for servers whose private CA needs one · Added CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_EFFORT to set the effort level subagents run at when nothing else names one, instead of inheriting the session's

items.text: We identified a security incident affecting a modified Claude Code VS Code extension accessed through our Cursor IDE extension marketplace, impacting at most 5,000 users. This malicious version of the extension was not developed by Anthropic. It does not impact other extensions…

items.title: Seems token recovery already began. Another little detail in addition to the effort described, user…
items.text: Seems token recovery already began. Another little detail in addition to the effort described, users pay trading fees on Binance in the coins they trade, so Binance's naturally accumulates all tokens they list. Your funds are SAFU!
